title: Crestline Fleet Account and Commercial Use of Rostered Vehicles
content:
Enrolling a vehicle on a Crestline Fleet Account roster makes it a vehicle in commercial use for the other Crestline products: tire treadwear coverage under the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty and Road Hazard Protection on its tires follow their commercial-use rules for as long as the vehicle was on a roster during the coverage.

## Boundaries of the fleet invoice

- The only road hazard plan that may be charged to a fleet account is the program's road hazard plan for fleet vehicles, Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; a consumer plan is never put on a fleet invoice.
- A fleet invoice is never paid with a personal Crestline Credit Card.
- Work on a vehicle not on the roster is never charged to the account.

## Quick reference

| Item | On a fleet invoice |
|---|---|
| Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection certificate on a rostered vehicle's tires | may be charged |
| a consumer road hazard plan | never |
| payment of the fleet invoice with a personal Crestline Credit Card | never |
| work on a vehicle not on the roster | never charged to the account |

## Hypothetical illustration

A pickup was on a contractor's roster for four months of a tire set's coverage period; for the treadwear coverage and the road hazard protection on those tires it is a vehicle in commercial use, and their commercial-use rules apply.
